raw_directive: Conduct a comprehensive audit and design plan for Army supply chains and the defense industry. 1. Evaluate procurement (tenders) and treat military equipment as a depreciating capital good. 2. Analyze storage for equipment, ammo, and gunpowder (CRITICAL: Must utilize our existing warehouse assets and storage payment logic; do not invent abstract multipliers). 3. Audit defense industry scaling, production methods, and the genesis state (initial firm/building spawn and subsequent growth). 4. Design a gradual, rational civilian-to-military industry conversion system that prevents economic collapse. 5. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: Military equipment requirements must be calculated based strictly on actual strategic needs of the army, absolutely NOT on general population metrics.
